name: Leela Palace Hotel New Delhi
positioning: The Leela Palace New Delhi, a palace-style city hotel echoing Lutyens' Delhi, in the Diplomatic Enclave of Chanakyapuri
best_for: Travelers who want a central New Delhi base in the Diplomatic Enclave
Guests interested in Indian art and evening cultural rituals

facts.text: The hotel stands on Africa Avenue in the Diplomatic Enclave in Chanakyapuri, a neighbourhood home to many embassies.
The hotel's architecture echoes the grandeur of Lutyens' Delhi, blended with contemporary styling.
The interiors feature artworks, hand-carved artefacts and brass accents by Indian artists.
The Spa offers European and Ayurveda-inspired therapies and holistic treatments.
Yoga and meditation sessions can be personalised for groups or private settings, and The Spa has a terrace.
The spa facilities include a steam room and sauna.
Bathrooms have spa mood lighting, with Ad Notam mirror TVs in specific suites.
Concierge services are Clefs d'Or recognised.
The ceremonial rituals include a showcase of classical music and dance in the hotel's gardens.
Jamavar serves royal Indian cuisine from across the country and is home to the Maharaja Table.
Megu serves modern Japanese cuisine and has an outdoor experience called Izakaya at Megu.

highlights.text: At dusk, guests can take part in rituals at the courtyard shrine of the hotel's resident goddess.
The hotel has a rooftop temperature-controlled swimming pool on the eleventh floor with views of the city skyline.
The hotel offers a guided art walk through installations, murals and sculptures by Indian artists.
Guests receive personalised hospitality services including a dedicated butler.
The suite categories include a Royal Suite with Plunge Pool.

considerations.text: Delhi's major sights such as the Red Fort, India Gate and Qutub Minar are off-site; the hotel can arrange half-day or full-day guided tours.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the hotel's high-end positioning.
WhataHotel notes the formal atmosphere may feel overly elaborate for casual travelers.
